title: 光學頻率梳穩定系統
summary: 以摻鉺光纖鎖模雷射為對象，從梳齒方程式與載波包絡偏移出發，建置超連續光譜、f-2f 干涉儀與 f_ceo／f_rep 兩個鎖相迴路，說明射頻與光學參考的槓桿效應、梳齒序數判定、週期滑脫與艾倫偏差評估，最後把熱漂移與致動器範圍整合成可全天候運行並可交接的頻率梳。
summaryEn: Taking an erbium-fibre mode-locked laser as the object, this course starts from the comb equation and the carrier-envelope offset, builds the supercontinuum, the f-2f interferometer and the two phase-locked loops for f_ceo and f_rep, explains the lever effect of RF versus optical references, mode-number determination, cycle slips and Allan-deviation evaluation, and finally integrates thermal drift and actuator ranges into a comb that runs around the clock and can be handed over.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 頻率梳設計核對：摻鉺光纖梳 f_rep = 250 MHz，f_ceo 鎖在 20 MHz。1550 nm（193.41 THz）的梳齒序數 n = 773,658；一支 1550 nm 連續波雷射與該梳齒拍頻 35.000 MHz，把 f_rep 提高 1.000 Hz 後拍頻變為 34.226 MHz（移動 773.66 kHz），證明 f_cw 高於梳齒且 n 正確。射頻參考：氫邁射 1 s 穩定度 1×10⁻¹³ 使光頻不確定度 = 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz；改用 1×10⁻¹⁵ 的腔穩頻雷射作光學參考則為 0.19 Hz。致動器：10 µm 壓電行程在 1.2 m 光程上給 ±1042 Hz 的 f_rep 範圍，對應梳齒 ±0.81 GHz；熱漂移 1850 Hz/K 表示溫度變化 0.56 K 就耗盡壓電，故外殼溫控 ±0.1 K（±185 Hz）並用步進平台卸載。鎖定品質：殘餘相位雜訊 σ_φ = 0.3 rad → 相干載波 exp(−0.09) = 91%；每秒一次週期滑脫等於 1 Hz = 5.2×10⁻¹⁵，遠高於雙梳比對的 2×10⁻¹⁶（1 s）基準，因此需要雙計數器滑脫偵測。所有數值皆為教學假設，不代表任何產品規格。
workedExample.textEn: Comb design check: an erbium fibre comb with f_rep = 250 MHz and f_ceo locked at 20 MHz. The tooth at 1550 nm (193.41 THz) has mode number n = 773,658; a 1550 nm cw laser beats with it at 35.000 MHz, and after raising f_rep by 1.000 Hz the beat becomes 34.226 MHz (a 773.66 kHz shift), proving that f_cw lies above the tooth and that n is right. RF reference: a hydrogen maser at 1×10⁻¹³ in 1 s gives an optical uncertainty of 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz; a 1×10⁻¹⁵ cavity-stabilised laser as optical reference gives 0.19 Hz. Actuators: a 10 µm piezo stroke on 1.2 m of optical path gives ±1042 Hz of f_rep range, ±0.81 GHz at the tooth; thermal drift of 1850 Hz/K means a 0.56 K change exhausts the piezo, so the housing is held to ±0.1 K (±185 Hz) and a stepper stage offloads. Lock quality: residual phase noise σ_φ = 0.3 rad → coherent carrier exp(−0.09) = 91%; one cycle slip per second equals 1 Hz = 5.2×10⁻¹⁵, far above the 2×10⁻¹⁶ (1 s) comb-versus-comb floor, hence dual-counter slip detection. All values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表實機量測、產品額定或操作參數；改變系統邊界後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not measured hardware, product ratings or operating parameters; recalculate after changing the system boundary.

workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and facility context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 系統邊界與物理原理
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應」與「倍頻程光譜與 f-2f 自參考」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb" and "Octave-spanning spectrum and f-2f self-referencing": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」如何決定光學頻率梳穩定系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase” determines the key performance of “Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鎖模雷射每隔 T_rep = 1/f_rep 發出一個脈衝，時域上的週期脈衝串在頻域上就是一排間距 f_rep 的譜線。但脈衝內的載波相對於包絡每一個脈衝會滑動一個相位 Δφ_ce，因為腔內群速度與相速度不同；這個逐脈衝相位滑移在頻域上把整排梳齒平移了 f_ceo = f_rep·Δφ_ce/(2π)，於是第 n 根梳齒的頻率為 f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo。只要兩個射頻量 f_rep 與 f_ceo 被鎖定，數十萬根光學頻率的梳齒就全部被鎖定，這就是頻率梳把光頻與射頻連接起來的原理。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A mode-locked laser emits one pulse every T_rep = 1/f_rep, and a periodic pulse train in time is a row of lines spaced f_rep in frequency. Inside each pulse, however, the carrier slips by a phase Δφ_ce relative to the envelope from pulse to pulse because group and phase velocities in the cavity differ; in the frequency domain this per-pulse slip shifts the whole row by f_ceo = f_rep·Δφ_ce/(2π), so the n-th tooth sits at f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo. Locking the two radio frequencies f_rep and f_ceo locks all several hundred thousand optical teeth at once, which is how a comb links optical and radio frequencies. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：取 f_rep = 250 MHz、f_ceo = 20 MHz（教學假設）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Take f_rep = 250 MHz and f_ceo = 20 MHz (teaching assumptions).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鎖定 f_rep 就等於鎖定了所有梳齒的絕對頻率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Locking f_rep alone fixes the absolute frequency of every tooth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：取 f_rep = 250 MHz、f_ceo = 20 MHz（教學假設）。1550 nm 對應 f = c/λ = 193.41 THz，梳齒序數 n = 193.41×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 773,658；逐脈衝載波包絡相位滑移 Δφ_ce = 2π·f_ceo/f_rep = 2π×20/250 = 0.503 rad，即每 12.5 個脈衝載波相位轉滿一圈。光譜中相鄰梳齒間距 250 MHz 相當於 1550 nm 處 2.0 pm 的波長間隔。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Take f_rep = 250 MHz and f_ceo = 20 MHz (teaching assumptions). At 1550 nm, f = c/λ = 193.41 THz and the mode number is n = 193.41×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 773,658; the per-pulse carrier-envelope slip is Δφ_ce = 2π·f_ceo/f_rep = 2π×20/250 = 0.503 rad, so the carrier phase completes one turn every 12.5 pulses. The 250 MHz tooth spacing corresponds to a 2.0 pm wavelength interval at 1550 nm. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用高速光二極體與頻譜分析儀觀察脈衝串，確認 f_rep 的基頻與諧波乾淨、無次諧波（表示單脈衝運轉）；再以 1 GHz 解析度的光譜儀確認光譜為平滑包絡而非多波長競爭。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe the pulse train with a fast photodiode and spectrum analyser, confirming a clean f_rep fundamental and harmonics without sub-harmonics (single-pulse operation); then check with an optical spectrum analyser at 1 GHz resolution that the spectrum is a smooth envelope rather than competing wavelengths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 鎖模脈衝串與頻率梳的對應：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The mode-locked pulse train and its frequency comb: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「梳齒方程式與載波包絡相位」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 用高速光二極體與頻譜分析儀觀察脈衝串，確認 f_rep 的基頻與諧波乾淨、無次諧波（表示單脈衝運轉）；再以 1 GHz 解析度的光譜儀確認光譜為平滑包絡而非多波長競爭。f_rep 以計數器對氫邁射計數，記錄自由運轉的漂移速率作為後續伺服設計的輸入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe the pulse train with a fast photodiode and spectrum analyser, confirming a clean f_rep fundamental and harmonics without sub-harmonics (single-pulse operation); then check with an optical spectrum analyser at 1 GHz resolution that the spectrum is a smooth envelope rather than competing wavelengths. Count f_rep against a hydrogen maser and record the free-running drift rate as input to the servo design. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：雷射進入多脈衝或 Q 切換鎖模狀態，f_rep 頻譜出現邊帶與次諧波，梳齒不再是單一等間距序列，後續的 f_ceo 拍頻消失，整套穩頻系統無從啟動。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: If the laser slips into multi-pulse or Q-switched mode locking, the f_rep spectrum shows sidebands and sub-harmonics, the teeth are no longer one equally spaced series, the f_ceo beat vanishes and the stabilization chain cannot start.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 用高速光二極體與頻譜分析儀觀察脈衝串，確認 f_rep 的基頻與諧波乾淨、無次諧波（表示單脈衝運轉）；再以 1 GHz 解析度的光譜儀確認光譜為平滑包絡而非多波長競爭。f_rep 以計數器對氫邁射計數，記錄自由運轉的漂移速率作為後續伺服設計的輸入。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

steps.title: 倍頻程光譜與 f-2f 自參考：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「f-2f 干涉儀與 f_ceo 拍頻」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “f-2f interferometer and the f_ceo beat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：摻鉺梳的超連續光譜涵蓋約 1000–2200 nm。取 2100 nm 端：f = 142.76 THz，n = 142.76×10¹²/250×10⁶ ≈ 571,033；倍頻後 285.5 THz（1050 nm），與序數 2n = 1,142,066 的梳齒拍頻：2(n·f_rep + f_ceo) − (2n·f_rep + f_ceo) = f_ceo = 20 MHz。若 f_ceo 自由運轉線寬 100 kHz，鎖相迴路頻寬必須大於此值的數倍，故 f_ceo 伺服常設計在 200–300 kHz。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The erbium comb's supercontinuum spans roughly 1000–2200 nm. With a free-running f_ceo linewidth of 100 kHz the phase-lock bandwidth must exceed it several times over, so the f_ceo servo is usually designed for 200–300 kHz. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在頻譜分析儀上以 100 kHz 解析頻寬看 f_ceo 拍頻，確認訊雜比 ≥ 30 dB 且在 f_rep − f_ceo 處有鏡像拍頻；調整 PPLN 溫度（相位匹配）與 f-2f 干涉儀兩臂的延遲，使拍頻最大化；改變泵浦電流 1 mA 並記錄 f_ceo 的移動，得到伺服所需的致動係數。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 光纖梳的元件鏈與致動器：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: The fibre comb's component chain and actuators: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN」如何決定光學頻率梳穩定系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN” determines the key performance of “Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摻鉺光纖振盪器（非線性偏振旋轉或 SESAM 鎖模）產生 250 MHz、數十 fs 的脈衝，經 EDFA 放大到數百 mW 後送入色散設計過的高非線性光纖產生超連續，再以 PPLN 倍頻。穩頻需要三類致動器：貼在光纖或腔鏡上的壓電致動器改變腔長以控制 f_rep（範圍數 kHz、頻寬數十 kHz）；腔內電光調制器提供 MHz 等級頻寬但只有 Hz 等級範圍；泵浦二極體電流透過腔內功率改變非線性相位來控制 f_ceo，頻寬受鉺增益動態限制在約 100 kHz；溫度或步進馬達平台則補償長期漂移。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An erbium fibre oscillator (nonlinear polarization rotation or SESAM mode locking) produces 250 MHz pulses of tens of femtoseconds, an EDFA amplifies them to a few hundred milliwatts, a dispersion-engineered highly nonlinear fibre generates the supercontinuum and a PPLN doubles it. Stabilization needs three classes of actuator: a piezo on the fibre or a cavity mirror changes cavity length to control f_rep (range of a few kHz, bandwidth of tens of kHz); an intracavity electro-optic modulator offers megahertz bandwidth but only hertz-level range; the pump-diode current controls f_ceo through the intracavity-power-dependent nonlinear phase with a bandwidth limited by erbium gain dynamics to about 100 kHz; temperature or a stepper stage absorbs long-term drift. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：250 MHz 的腔光學長度 L = c/f_rep = 1.2 m（光纖物理長度約 0.82 m）。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: A 250 MHz cavity has optical length L = c/f_rep = 1.2 m (about 0.82 m of physical fibre).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個行程夠大的壓電致動器就能同時處理 f_rep 的快速雜訊與慢速漂移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One piezo with enough stroke can handle both the fast noise and the slow drift of f_rep." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 光纖梳的元件鏈與致動器：定量估算
steps.titleEn: The fibre comb's component chain and actuators: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：250 MHz 的腔光學長度 L = c/f_rep = 1.2 m（光纖物理長度約 0.82 m）。壓電致動器行程 10 µm 時 Δf_rep = f_rep·ΔL/L = 250×10⁶×10×10⁻⁶/1.2 = 2083 Hz；對序數 773,658 的梳齒，光頻移動 n·Δf_rep = 773,658×2083 Hz ≈ 1.61 GHz。這個「槓桿」表示 f_rep 的 1 Hz 變化在 1550 nm 等於 774 kHz，所以 f_rep 伺服的精度要求比 f_ceo 嚴格六個數量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: A 250 MHz cavity has optical length L = c/f_rep = 1.2 m (about 0.82 m of physical fibre). A piezo stroke of 10 µm gives Δf_rep = f_rep·ΔL/L = 250×10⁶×10×10⁻⁶/1.2 = 2083 Hz; for tooth number 773,658 the optical frequency moves by n·Δf_rep = 773,658×2083 Hz ≈ 1.61 GHz. This lever means a 1 Hz change of f_rep equals 774 kHz at 1550 nm, so the f_rep servo precision requirement is six orders of magnitude tighter than that for f_ceo. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個致動器量轉移函數：以網路分析儀從 1 Hz 掃到 1 MHz，記錄 f_rep 或 f_ceo 對驅動的響應幅度與相位，標出壓電機械共振與泵浦電流的增益滾降頻率；確認壓電行程換算的 Δf_rep 與 2083 Hz 的估計相符，並確認 EOM 的範圍與頻寬能覆蓋壓電共振以上的頻段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure each actuator's transfer function with a network analyser swept from 1 Hz to 1 MHz, recording the amplitude and phase of f_rep or f_ceo against drive, marking the piezo mechanical resonance and the pump-current gain roll-off; confirm that the piezo stroke converts to a Δf_rep consistent with the 2083 Hz estimate and that the EOM's range and bandwidth cover the band above the piezo resonance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 光纖梳的元件鏈與致動器：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: The fibre comb's component chain and actuators: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「摻鉺振盪器、EDFA、HNLF 與 PPLN」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Er oscillator, EDFA, HNLF and PPLN” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 對每個致動器量轉移函數：以網路分析儀從 1 Hz 掃到 1 MHz，記錄 f_rep 或 f_ceo 對驅動的響應幅度與相位，標出壓電機械共振與泵浦電流的增益滾降頻率；確認壓電行程換算的 Δf_rep 與 2083 Hz 的估計相符，並確認 EOM 的範圍與頻寬能覆蓋壓電共振以上的頻段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure each actuator's transfer function with a network analyser swept from 1 Hz to 1 MHz, recording the amplitude and phase of f_rep or f_ceo against drive, marking the piezo mechanical resonance and the pump-current gain roll-off; confirm that the piezo stroke converts to a Δf_rep consistent with the 2083 Hz estimate and that the EOM's range and bandwidth cover the band above the piezo resonance. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：壓電致動器的機械共振在 20 kHz 且未加陷波濾波，伺服增益提高時迴路在共振處振盪，f_rep 出現 20 kHz 邊帶，所有梳齒被調制成多條線，光頻量測出現數百 kHz 的假偏移。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: A piezo with a 20 kHz mechanical resonance and no notch filter oscillates at the resonance when servo gain is raised, f_rep acquires 20 kHz sidebands, every tooth splits into several lines and optical-frequency measurements show spurious offsets of hundreds of kilohertz.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 鎖相架構：射頻參考與光學參考的槓桿：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lock architecture: the lever of RF versus optical references: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「f_rep／f_ceo 鎖相迴路與參考源」如何決定光學頻率梳穩定系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “f_rep/f_ceo phase-locked loops and references” determines the key performance of “Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個迴路各自把一個拍頻與合成器輸出的相位差送入 PID 控制器：f_ceo 迴路驅動泵浦電流，f_rep 迴路驅動壓電與 EOM。參考源有兩種選擇：射頻參考（氫邁射或銫鐘）把 f_rep 直接鎖到 10 MHz 的倍頻鏈上，但 f_rep 的相位雜訊會被乘上 n² 的功率比例傳到光頻；光學參考則把某一根梳齒與腔穩頻的連續波雷射拍頻鎖定，光頻的穩定度由參考雷射決定，再把 f_rep 當作輸出而非輸入。現代光鐘系統幾乎都用後者，射頻參考只用來計數與提供長期準確度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「f_rep／f_ceo 鎖相迴路與參考源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Each loop feeds the phase difference between a beat and a synthesizer output into a PID controller: the f_ceo loop drives the pump current, the f_rep loop drives piezo and EOM. Two kinds of reference exist: an RF reference (hydrogen maser or caesium clock) locks f_rep to a multiplied 10 MHz chain, but the f_rep phase noise is transferred to the optical teeth multiplied by n² in power; an optical reference locks the beat between one tooth and a cavity-stabilised cw laser, the optical stability is set by that laser and f_rep becomes an output rather than an input. Modern optical-clock systems almost always use the latter, keeping the RF reference for counting and long-term accuracy. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “f_rep/f_ceo phase-locked loops and references”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：相位雜訊的槓桿為 20·log₁₀(n) = 20·log₁₀(773,658) = 117.8 dB：f_rep 在偏移 1 kHz 處 −150 dBc/Hz 的雜訊，在 193 THz 的梳齒上變成 −32 dBc/Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The phase-noise lever is 20·log₁₀(n) = 20·log₁₀(773,658) = 117.8 dB: f_rep noise of −150 dBc/Hz at 1 kHz offset becomes −32 dBc/Hz on the 193 THz tooth.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要射頻參考夠好，用射頻鎖定的頻率梳在光頻就和光學參考一樣穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With a good enough RF reference, an RF-locked comb is as stable at optical frequencies as an optically referenced one." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：相位雜訊的槓桿為 20·log₁₀(n) = 20·log₁₀(773,658) = 117.8 dB：f_rep 在偏移 1 kHz 處 −150 dBc/Hz 的雜訊，在 193 THz 的梳齒上變成 −32 dBc/Hz。氫邁射 1 s 穩定度 1×10⁻¹³ 對應光頻不確定度 193.41 THz×10⁻¹³ = 19.3 Hz；改用 1×10⁻¹⁵ 的腔穩頻雷射作光學參考，1 s 的光頻不確定度降到 0.19 Hz，此時 f_rep 的 1 s 穩定度 = 1×10⁻¹⁵，遠優於任何射頻源。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The phase-noise lever is 20·log₁₀(n) = 20·log₁₀(773,658) = 117.8 dB: f_rep noise of −150 dBc/Hz at 1 kHz offset becomes −32 dBc/Hz on the 193 THz tooth. steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「f_rep／f_ceo 鎖相迴路與參考源」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “f_rep/f_ceo phase-locked loops and references” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 鎖定後用第二台頻譜分析儀看迴路內誤差訊號的相位雜訊譜，確認伺服凸峰（servo bump）位置與設計頻寬一致且凸峰高度低於 10 dB；再把同一支連續波雷射與梳齒的拍頻送到迴路外的計數器，比較迴路內與迴路外的艾倫偏差，兩者的差異就是未被伺服看見的路徑雜訊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: After locking, examine the in-loop error signal's phase-noise spectrum on a second analyser, confirming that the servo bump sits at the designed bandwidth and is lower than 10 dB; then send the beat between the same cw laser and the comb to an out-of-loop counter and compare in-loop and out-of-loop Allan deviations, their difference being the path noise the servo never sees. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：以 10 MHz 石英振盪器當 f_rep 參考並直接倍頻，117.8 dB 的槓桿把石英的相位雜訊放大，193 THz 梳齒的線寬達數百 kHz，與任何窄線寬雷射的拍頻都無法計數。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: Using a 10 MHz quartz oscillator as the f_rep reference and multiplying it directly lets the 117.8 dB lever amplify the quartz phase noise, the 193 THz teeth acquire linewidths of hundreds of kilohertz and the beat with any narrow-linewidth laser cannot be counted.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

stages.title: 量測、校正與誤差預算
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「絕對光頻量測：序數、符號與計數」與「殘餘雜訊、週期滑脫與誤差預算」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Absolute optical-frequency measurement: mode number, signs and counting" and "Residual noise, cycle slips and the error budget": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 絕對光頻量測：序數、符號與計數：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Absolute optical-frequency measurement: mode number, signs and counting: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「梳齒序數 n 與符號判定」如何決定光學頻率梳穩定系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mode number n and sign determination” determines the key performance of “Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測一支連續波雷射的絕對頻率時，f_cw = n·f_rep ± f_ceo ± f_beat，四種符號組合與序數 n 都要被判定。序數靠波長計：只要波長計的準確度優於 f_rep/2，就能唯一指定 n；符號靠擾動：把 f_rep 略微提高，若拍頻隨之下降則 f_cw 在梳齒之上，再把 f_ceo 鎖定點改變看拍頻方向就能定第二個符號。計數時用無死區的計數器，並以兩台計數器（不同閘門時間或相位記錄模式）平行計數偵測週期滑脫。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「梳齒序數 n 與符號判定」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: To measure a cw laser's absolute frequency, f_cw = n·f_rep ± f_ceo ± f_beat, and both the mode number n and the four sign combinations must be determined. The mode number comes from a wavemeter: an accuracy better than f_rep/2 assigns n uniquely; the signs come from perturbation: raise f_rep slightly and if the beat falls the laser lies above the tooth, then change the f_ceo lock point and watch the beat direction to fix the second sign. Counting uses dead-time-free counters, and two counters run in parallel (different gate times or phase-recording mode) to detect cycle slips. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Mode number n and sign determination”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：f_rep 改變 +1.000 Hz 時，第 773,658 根梳齒移動 773,658 Hz = 773.66 kHz；拍頻由 35.000 MHz 變為 34.226 MHz 就表示 f_cw 高於梳齒、且 n 可由位移量除以 1 Hz 直接核對。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Changing f_rep by +1.000 Hz moves tooth 773,658 by 773,658 Hz = 773.66 kHz; if the beat goes from 35.000 MHz to 34.226 MHz the laser lies above the tooth, and n is checked directly as the shift divided by 1 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拍頻計數穩定就代表絕對頻率正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A stable beat count proves the absolute frequency is right." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「梳齒序數 n 與符號判定」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Mode number n and sign determination”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 絕對光頻量測：序數、符號與計數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absolute optical-frequency measurement: mode number, signs and counting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梳齒序數 n 與符號判定」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mode number n and sign determination” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：f_rep 改變 +1.000 Hz 時，第 773,658 根梳齒移動 773,658 Hz = 773.66 kHz；拍頻由 35.000 MHz 變為 34.226 MHz 就表示 f_cw 高於梳齒、且 n 可由位移量除以 1 Hz 直接核對。波長計準確度需 < f_rep/2 = 125 MHz，相當於 1550 nm 處 1 pm；商用波長計 ±30 MHz 足夠。單次計數閘門 1 s 時，一次 2π 的週期滑脫 = 1 Hz 誤差 = 193.41 THz 的 5.2×10⁻¹⁵，比梳本身 10⁻¹⁶ 的貢獻大 50 倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Changing f_rep by +1.000 Hz moves tooth 773,658 by 773,658 Hz = 773.66 kHz; if the beat goes from 35.000 MHz to 34.226 MHz the laser lies above the tooth, and n is checked directly as the shift divided by 1 Hz. The wavemeter accuracy must be < f_rep/2 = 125 MHz, about 1 pm at 1550 nm, so a commercial ±30 MHz wavemeter suffices. With a 1 s counting gate, one 2π cycle slip equals a 1 Hz error, 5.2×10⁻¹⁵ of 193.41 THz, fifty times larger than the comb's own 10⁻¹⁶ contribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用一支已知頻率的參考（例如鎖在乙炔或銣吸收線上的雷射，或另一台獨立頻率梳）做盲測：以上述程序判定 n 與符號並計數 1000 s，結果應落在參考值的不確定度內；同時比較兩台計數器的讀值，任何一秒的差異 ≥ 1 Hz 就標記為週期滑脫並剔除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run a blind test with a reference of known frequency (a laser locked to an acetylene or rubidium line, or a second independent comb): determine n and the signs by the procedure above, count for 1000 s and confirm the result lies within the reference's uncertainty; compare the two counters' readings throughout and flag any second differing by ≥ 1 Hz as a cycle slip to be discarded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

steps.title: 殘餘雜訊、週期滑脫與誤差預算：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual noise, cycle slips and the error budget: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「雙梳比對與艾倫偏差」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Comb-versus-comb comparison and Allan deviation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 把兩台梳鎖到同一支 1542 nm 超穩雷射，各自在 1064 nm 取一根梳齒拍頻並計數 10⁴ s，計算艾倫偏差並確認斜率為 −1；把功率改變 ±3 dB、偏振旋轉 10°，記錄拍頻中心是否移動 > 1 mHz，以此量化功率與偏振相關偏移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Lock two combs to the same 1542 nm ultrastable laser, beat one tooth of each at 1064 nm, count for 10⁴ s, compute the Allan deviation and confirm a slope of −1; change the power by ±3 dB and rotate the polarization by 10° and record whether the beat centre moves by more than 1 mHz, quantifying power- and polarization-dependent offsets. steps.observation: 注意干擾：梳輸出經過 20 m 未補償的光纖送到光鐘實驗室，實驗室空調的溫度循環在光纖上造成每 10 分鐘數百 rad 的相位漂移，比對結果在 100–1000 s 出現平台，被誤判為光鐘本身的不穩定。

steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。

steps.title: 系統整合：環境、致動器分配與傳輸：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: System integration: environment, actuator allocation and delivery: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除」如何決定光學頻率梳穩定系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal drift, actuator range and fibre-noise cancellation” determines the key performance of “Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 全天候運轉的關鍵是把雜訊按頻段分配給正確的致動器，並讓環境漂移不耗盡任何一個致動器的範圍：EOM 處理 10 kHz 以上、壓電處理 1 Hz–10 kHz、步進平台或溫控處理更慢的漂移，各迴路之間以積分器「卸載」（offloading）把慢速累積交給大範圍致動器。光纖的熱光係數使腔長隨溫度變化，必須用隔熱與溫控外殼壓低；梳光送到他處使用時，傳輸光纖的相位雜訊以往返干涉法主動消除。偏振、泵浦功率與 EDFA 增益都要有監控點。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Round-the-clock operation hinges on assigning noise bands to the right actuators and keeping environmental drift from exhausting any actuator's range: the EOM handles above 10 kHz, the piezo 1 Hz to 10 kHz, and a stepper stage or temperature control the slower drift, with integrators offloading slow accumulation from fast actuators to the large-range ones. The thermo-optic coefficient of fibre makes cavity length track temperature, which insulation and a temperature-controlled housing must suppress; when comb light is delivered elsewhere, the phase noise of the transport fibre is cancelled actively with a round-trip interferometer. Polarization, pump power and EDFA gain all need monitoring points. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Thermal drift, actuator range and fibre-noise cancellation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：矽光纖的有效光程溫度係數約 7.4×10⁻⁶/K（熱光 6.9×10⁻⁶ 加熱膨脹 0.55×10⁻⁶），故 Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Silica fibre's effective optical-path temperature coefficient is about 7.4×10⁻⁶/K (thermo-optic 6.9×10⁻⁶ plus expansion 0.55×10⁻⁶), so Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鎖相迴路頻寬夠大，環境溫度變化就不會造成失鎖。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "With enough servo bandwidth, environmental temperature changes can never cause loss of lock." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 系統整合：環境、致動器分配與傳輸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: System integration: environment, actuator allocation and delivery: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal drift, actuator range and fibre-noise cancellation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：矽光纖的有效光程溫度係數約 7.4×10⁻⁶/K（熱光 6.9×10⁻⁶ 加熱膨脹 0.55×10⁻⁶），故 Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K。第 3 單元的壓電範圍 ±1042 Hz 只能吸收 ±0.56 K；若外殼溫控到 ±0.1 K，漂移 ±185 Hz，佔壓電範圍 18%，其餘留給聲學與氣壓擾動；超過 ±0.3 K 就必須由步進平台卸載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Silica fibre's effective optical-path temperature coefficient is about 7.4×10⁻⁶/K (thermo-optic 6.9×10⁻⁶ plus expansion 0.55×10⁻⁶), so Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K. The ±1042 Hz piezo range of unit 3 absorbs only ±0.56 K; with the housing controlled to ±0.1 K the drift is ±185 Hz, 18% of the piezo range, leaving the rest for acoustic and pressure disturbances; beyond ±0.3 K the stepper stage must offload. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, and state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄 24 小時的壓電驅動電壓、步進平台位置、外殼溫度與氣壓，畫成時間序列：壓電電壓應在範圍中央 ±30% 內擺動且與溫度無長期相關；若卸載正常，步進平台的位置曲線應與溫度曲線同形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log 24 hours of piezo drive voltage, stepper position, housing temperature and barometric pressure as time series: the piezo voltage should swing within ±30% of mid-range with no long-term correlation with temperature, and with offloading working the stepper position should mirror the temperature curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成設備規格，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit conversion slips, treating teaching assumptions as equipment specifications, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 重現模型中的數值（取整誤差在 ±5% 內），並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與物理解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values (within ±5% rounding) and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with a physical explanation.

knowledge.text: 矽光纖的有效光程溫度係數約 7.4×10⁻⁶/K（熱光 6.9×10⁻⁶ 加熱膨脹 0.55×10⁻⁶），故 Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K。第 3 單元的壓電範圍 ±1042 Hz 只能吸收 ±0.56 K；若外殼溫控到 ±0.1 K，漂移 ±185 Hz，佔壓電範圍 18%，其餘留給聲學與氣壓擾動；超過 ±0.3 K 就必須由步進平台卸載。
knowledge.textEn: Silica fibre's effective optical-path temperature coefficient is about 7.4×10⁻⁶/K (thermo-optic 6.9×10⁻⁶ plus expansion 0.55×10⁻⁶), so Δf_rep/ΔT = 250×10⁶×7.4×10⁻⁶ = 1850 Hz/K. The ±1042 Hz piezo range of unit 3 absorbs only ±0.56 K; with the housing controlled to ±0.1 K the drift is ±185 Hz, 18% of the piezo range, leaving the rest for acoustic and pressure disturbances; beyond ±0.3 K the stepper stage must offload.

steps.title: 系統整合：環境、致動器分配與傳輸：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: System integration: environment, actuator allocation and delivery: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「熱漂移、致動器範圍與光纖雜訊消除」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Thermal drift, actuator range and fibre-noise cancellation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 記錄 24 小時的壓電驅動電壓、步進平台位置、外殼溫度與氣壓，畫成時間序列：壓電電壓應在範圍中央 ±30% 內擺動且與溫度無長期相關；若卸載正常，步進平台的位置曲線應與溫度曲線同形。對傳輸光纖，用往返拍頻量測開啟與關閉消除時的艾倫偏差，確認關閉時 1 s 的 10⁻¹⁴ 等級雜訊被壓到 10⁻¹⁷ 以下。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log 24 hours of piezo drive voltage, stepper position, housing temperature and barometric pressure as time series: the piezo voltage should swing within ±30% of mid-range with no long-term correlation with temperature, and with offloading working the stepper position should mirror the temperature curve. For the transport fibre, measure the round-trip beat's Allan deviation with cancellation on and off, confirming that the 10⁻¹⁴-level 1 s noise when off is pushed below 10⁻¹⁷ when on. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：實驗室夜間空調停機，溫度漂移 2 K 使 f_rep 漂移 3.7 kHz，壓電在凌晨兩點到達行程極限而失鎖；次日早上發現整夜的光鐘比對資料只剩四小時有效。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The laboratory air-conditioning stops overnight, a 2 K drift moves f_rep by 3.7 kHz, the piezo hits its stroke limit at two in the morning and the lock is lost; next morning only four hours of the overnight clock comparison turn out to be valid.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

steps.title: 鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接：原理與系統邊界
steps.titleEn: Lock quality, acceptance criteria and engineering handoff: mechanism and system boundary
steps.objective: 說明「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」如何決定光學頻率梳穩定系統的關鍵性能，並畫出其輸入、輸出與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation” determines the key performance of “Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems”, and map its inputs, outputs and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 頻率梳的驗收不是「有拍頻就好」，而是用可量化的指標：殘餘相位雜訊積分值（決定多少功率在相干載波中）、f_ceo 與 f_rep 拍頻訊雜比、迴路外艾倫偏差、週期滑脫率、連續鎖定時數與自動重鎖能力。交接文件應包含每個致動器的轉移函數、伺服參數、鎖定點、所有拍頻的頻率與符號約定、波長計校正值、以及環境監測的正常範圍，讓接手者能在不重新摸索的情況下判斷系統是否仍處於驗收狀態。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Accepting a comb is not a matter of seeing a beat but of quantified indicators: the integrated residual phase noise (which sets how much power sits in the coherent carrier), the SNR of the f_ceo and f_rep beats, out-of-loop Allan deviation, cycle-slip rate, continuous lock time and automatic relock capability. The handoff file should contain each actuator's transfer function, servo parameters, lock points, the frequency and sign convention of every beat, the wavemeter calibration value and the normal range of every environmental monitor, so the next engineer can judge whether the system is still in its accepted state without rediscovering it. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：把 f_ceo 迴路的殘餘相位雜訊從 1 Hz 積分到 1 MHz 得 σ_φ = 0.3 rad（教學假設），相干載波功率比例 = exp(−σ_φ²) = exp(−0.09) = 0.91，即 91% 的功率在載波、9% 在雜訊基座；若 σ_φ 升到 1 rad，比例掉到 37%，拍頻看似仍在但計數開始跳動。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Integrating the f_ceo loop's residual phase noise from 1 Hz to 1 MHz gives σ_φ = 0.3 rad (teaching assumption), so the coherent-carrier fraction is exp(−σ_φ²) = exp(−0.09) = 0.91, i.e. 91% of the power in the carrier and 9% in the noise pedestal; at σ_φ = 1 rad the fraction drops to 37%, the beat still appears present but counts begin to jump.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「頻率梳是交鑰匙產品，開機鎖定後不需要任何驗收指標。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在方塊圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A frequency comb is a turnkey product that needs no acceptance metrics once it locks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your block diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 方塊圖標明「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」的輸入、輸出與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The block diagram shows inputs, outputs and boundaries of “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lock quality, acceptance criteria and engineering handoff: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of changes when a parameter moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：把 f_ceo 迴路的殘餘相位雜訊從 1 Hz 積分到 1 MHz 得 σ_φ = 0.3 rad（教學假設），相干載波功率比例 = exp(−σ_φ²) = exp(−0.09) = 0.91，即 91% 的功率在載波、9% 在雜訊基座；若 σ_φ 升到 1 rad，比例掉到 37%，拍頻看似仍在但計數開始跳動。驗收門檻常訂為 σ_φ ≤ 0.5 rad（載波 ≥ 78%）、24 小時內週期滑脫 0 次、拍頻訊雜比 ≥ 30 dB。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Integrating the f_ceo loop's residual phase noise from 1 Hz to 1 MHz gives σ_φ = 0.3 rad (teaching assumption), so the coherent-carrier fraction is exp(−σ_φ²) = exp(−0.09) = 0.91, i.e. 91% of the power in the carrier and 9% in the noise pedestal; at σ_φ = 1 rad the fraction drops to 37%, the beat still appears present but counts begin to jump. Typical acceptance thresholds are σ_φ ≤ 0.5 rad (carrier ≥ 78%), zero cycle slips in 24 hours and beat SNR ≥ 30 dB. steps.title: 鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接：量測與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lock quality, acceptance criteria and engineering handoff: measurement and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的量測，驗證「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」是否符合模型預期，並訂出允收準則。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable measurement that verifies whether “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation” meets the model expectation, and set acceptance criteria.
steps.instruction: 執行 24 小時驗收運轉：每秒記錄兩台計數器的 f_ceo、f_rep 與連續波拍頻、壓電電壓與溫度；驗收後統計滑脫次數、計算迴路外艾倫偏差、用頻譜分析儀的相位雜訊量測積分出 σ_φ，並把結果與門檻一起寫入交接報告；刻意拔除再接回參考訊號，確認自動重鎖在 10 秒內完成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成量測計畫，列出儀器、基準件或參考樣品、步驟、比較對象與允收準則，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run a 24 hour acceptance run logging, every second, the f_ceo, f_rep and cw beat readings of both counters together with piezo voltage and temperature; afterwards count the slips, compute the out-of-loop Allan deviation, integrate σ_φ from the spectrum analyser's phase-noise measurement, and enter the results with the thresholds in the handoff report; deliberately disconnect and reconnect the reference to confirm automatic relock within 10 seconds. Mentor task: turn this into a measurement plan listing instruments, reference artefacts or samples, procedure, comparison baseline and acceptance criteria, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 注意干擾：交接時只留下「正常可用」四個字與一組伺服設定值，沒有致動器轉移函數與符號約定；半年後更換泵浦二極體，f_ceo 致動係數反號，接手者把迴路接成正回授，花了兩週才找出為何永遠鎖不住。
steps.observationEn: Watch for interference: The handoff leaves only the words works normally and one set of servo values, with no actuator transfer functions or sign conventions; six months later a pump diode is replaced, the f_ceo actuator coefficient changes sign, the successor wires the loop as positive feedback and spends two weeks discovering why it never locks.
steps.failure: 驗證陷阱：只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Verification traps: a single measurement, no traceable reference, or unrecorded environmental conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格。
steps.checkEn: Submit the measurement plan: instruments, reference, procedure, acceptance criteria and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail decision rule.

knowledge.text: 執行 24 小時驗收運轉：每秒記錄兩台計數器的 f_ceo、f_rep 與連續波拍頻、壓電電壓與溫度；驗收後統計滑脫次數、計算迴路外艾倫偏差、用頻譜分析儀的相位雜訊量測積分出 σ_φ，並把結果與門檻一起寫入交接報告；刻意拔除再接回參考訊號，確認自動重鎖在 10 秒內完成。

knowledge.title: 允收與不確定度
knowledge.text: 允收準則必須在量測前訂定，並與擴充不確定度一起陳述；比較基準需可追溯。
knowledge.textEn: Acceptance criteria are fixed before measuring and stated together with expanded uncertainty; the comparison reference must be traceable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 鎖定品質、驗收準則與工程交接：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lock quality, acceptance criteria and engineering handoff: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鎖定品質報告與全天候驗證」的失效原因，提出能區分原因的檢查與矯正措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure causes of “Lock-quality record and round-the-clock validation” and propose discriminating checks and corrective actions.
steps.instruction: 交接時只留下「正常可用」四個字與一組伺服設定值，沒有致動器轉移函數與符號約定；半年後更換泵浦二極體，f_ceo 致動係數反號，接手者把迴路接成正回授，花了兩週才找出為何永遠鎖不住。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整個系統的性能、良率或安全。
steps.instructionEn: The handoff leaves only the words works normally and one set of servo values, with no actuator transfer functions or sign conventions; six months later a pump diode is replaced, the f_ceo actuator coefficient changes sign, the successor wires the loop as positive feedback and spends two weeks discovering why it never locks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system performance, yield or safety.
steps.observation: 連結機制：交接文件應包含每個致動器的轉移函數、伺服參數、鎖定點、所有拍頻的頻率與符號約定、波長計校正值、以及環境監測的正常範圍，讓接手者能在不重新摸索的情況下判斷系統是否仍處於驗收狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The handoff file should contain each actuator's transfer function, servo parameters, lock points, the frequency and sign convention of every beat, the wavemeter calibration value and the normal range of every environmental monitor, so the next engineer can judge whether the system is still in its accepted state without rediscovering it.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頻率梳是交鑰匙產品，開機鎖定後不需要任何驗收指標。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A frequency comb is a turnkey product that needs no acceptance metrics once it locks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，並指出哪一項量測能最快確認根因、如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement that confirms the root cause fastest, and state how recurrence is prevented.
